scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const f='node_modules/@capacitor/cli/bin/capacitor'; if(fs.existsSync(f)){let s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'); s=s.replace('process.exit(1)','/*process.exit(1)*/'); fs.writeFileSync(f,s);} const b='node_modules/@capacitor/android/capacitor/build.gradle'; if(fs.existsSync(b)){let s=fs.readFileSync(b,'utf8'); s=s.replaceAll('JavaVersion.VERSION_21','JavaVersion.VERSION_17'); fs.writeFileSync(b,s);}"
